name: travelcraft
description: Local-first, offline Baedeker travel primer for Austria and Japan: chrono-cartography, sensory atmosphere, route optimization, and SightLens.

tools.name: travel_status
tools.description: Report editions, persistence status, db path, journal count, and vendored source list

tools.name: travel_countries
tools.description: List all sovereign country editions with curated routes

tools.name: travel_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a country edition: chrono-waypoints, sensory atmosphere, and routes

tools.name: travel_knowledge_tree
tools.description: Retrieve hierarchical Baedeker primer topic tree for a country

tools.name: travel_plan_route
tools.description: Calculate chrono-optimised route: legs, distance, hours, carbon, map tiles

tools.name: travel_itinerary
tools.description: Generate day-by-day itinerary plan for stays (1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 14 days)

tools.name: travel_identify_sight
tools.description: Identify a sight or artwork from the offline catalogue using GPS and optional hint

tools.name: travel_sight_chat
tools.description: Offline grounded answer plus system prompt, map blob, and transit blob

tools.name: travel_sightlens_capture
tools.description: Capture sight identification and persist a durable journal entry

tools.name: travel_journal_add
tools.description: Add user reflection and sensory notes to durable SQLite journal

tools.name: travel_journal_list
tools.description: List durable journal entries, newest first

tools.name: travel_nearby
tools.description: Look up nearby points of interest via OpenStreetMap Overpass with local caching
